facts.fact: Sunni's mother returns Badami's dented bell and Meera tells her to bury it with Sunni; the bell is buried with the child and Meera no longer carries it.
facts.why: needed because the bell was lent to Sunni in ch 18 and she died holding it; this resolves the object.

facts.fact: The regent's patrol wears grey wool with a small brass bell stitched on each shoulder; the captain has a red moustache and one soldier is called Pasang.
facts.why: needed to show a regent's patrol on the page.

facts.fact: Nimmi's goat shed is a lean-to behind her house with three goats and a hay loft; the patrol marks its door with an ash handprint.
The patrol marks every sick house with a plate-wide ash handprint on the lintel, and says no one may go in or out of a marked house after the sixth day without a pass.
facts.why: needed to plant C26 (the cleansing order) concretely.

facts.fact: Nimmi estimates eight days until the Snow Fair if the road holds, with the general to ride up after it.
facts.why: needed to answer 'how long' as a reader question.
